examples.text: akuppo calayitum'asakkuṇeyyo arahattaphaladhammo assā'ti akuppadhammo.
velā'ti duccaritehi anatikkamanīy'aṭṭhena velā, sīmā'ti attho. velāyati vā dussilyaṃ calayati viddhaṃsetī'ti velā.
kusalan'ti etth'āyaṃ vacan'attho, kucchite pāpadhamme salayati calayati kampetī'ti kusalaṃ, kucchitena vā ākārena sayantī'ti kusā, pāpakā dhammā. te kuse lunāti chindatī'ti kusalaṃ.

90182.meaning1: in reference to AN5.131 Paṭhamacakkānuvattanasutta and AN5.132 Dutiyacakkānuvattanasutta

examples.text: cakk'ānuvattanā rājā, yassaṃdisaṃ dve c'eva patthanā, appaṃsupati bhatt'ādo, akkhamo ca sotena cā'ti.
evam'eva kho, mahārāja, tathāgato vimuttivarasalilasampuṇṇaṃ saddhammavarataḷākaṃ māpesi ye keci kilesamalakiliṭṭhā sacetanā budhā, te idha nahāyitvā sabbakilese pavāhayissantī'ti.
ogaha rahadaṃ akaddamaṃ, sabbaṃ sedamalaṃ pavāhaya, gaṇhāhi navaṃ vilepanaṃ, yassa gandho na kadāci chijjati.

90185.meaning1: (of a musical instrument) plays; sounds; resounds

examples.text: buddhassa ānubhāvena, bherī vajjum'aghaṭṭitā, sayaṃ vīṇā pavajjanti, buddhassa pavisato puraṃ.

90186.grammar: pr, pass of roseti, caus, trans (+acc)
90186.meaning1: is irritated; is annoyed; is angered; is infuriated

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato ekena vā saravegena viddho, dvīhi vā tīhi vā catūhi vā pañcahi vā saravegehi viddho saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.

90188.meaning2: cause to blaze up; kindles; lights
90188.commentary: (BVa) ukkā vā padīpe vā keci'pi janā na ujjālenti na pajjālenti.

examples.text: na keci tena samayena, samantā yojane janā, ukkāpadīpe ujjālenti, buddharaṃsīhi otthaṭā.
māsassa pana aṭṭhadivase devaloke mahādhammasavanaṃ ghusati.
imaṃ tuṇḍehi pakkhehi, pādā c'imaṃ viheṭhatha, chavañ'h'imaṃ vināsetha, n'āyaṃ saṃvāsan'āraho'ti.

90191.meaning1: easy to get rid of; easy to dispel; easy to remove

examples.text: ime pañca duppaṭivinodayā'ti na supaṭivinodayā, upāyena pana kāraṇena anurūpāhi paccavekkhanā-anusāsan'ādīhi sakkā paṭivinodetun'ti attho.

examples.text: jānanto bodhisatto taṃ khippam'eva paṭivinodayitvā yācake pariyesetvā'pi deti, yañ'ca deyyavatthu parittaṃ, yācako'pi paccupaṭṭhito, taṃ acintetvā api attānaṃ dhāvitvā dento yācakaṃ sammāneti yathā taṃ akittipaṇḍito

90194.commentary: (ANa) ito bhogena paṭisantharissāmī'ti ito mama sāpateyyato bhogaṃ gahetvā tena paṭisanthāraṃ karissāmi, tassa ca mama ca antaraṃ pidahissāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro aḍḍho hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo. tassa evaṃ hoti, sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ito bhogena paṭisantharissāmī'ti. sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tato bhogena paṭisantharati.

90195.meaning1: pays off; settles; sorts out (with a bribe)
90195.commentary: (ANa) ito bhogena paṭisantharissāmī'ti ito mama sāpateyyato bhogaṃ gahetvā tena paṭisanthāraṃ karissāmi, tassa ca mama ca antaraṃ pidahissāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro aḍḍho hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo. tassa evaṃ hoti, sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ito bhogena paṭisantharissāmī'ti. sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tato bhogena paṭisantharati.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, mahācoro ekacārī hoti? idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro ekako'va gahaṇāni kattā hoti. taṃ kissa hetu?

sappāyakārī hoti, sappāye mattaṃ jānāti, bhesajjaṃ paṭisevitā hoti, atthakāmassa gilān'upaṭṭhākassa yathābhūtaṃ ābādhaṃ āvikattā hoti abhikkamantaṃ vā abhikkamatī'ti paṭikkamantaṃ vā paṭikkamatīti ṭhitaṃ vā ṭhito'ti, uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko hoti.

mātā jīvitā voropitā hoti, pitā jīvitā voropito hoti, arahaṃ jīvitā voropito hoti, tathāgatassa duṭṭhena cittena lohitaṃ uppāditaṃ hoti, saṅgho bhinno hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca āpāyikā nerayikā parikuppā atekicchā'ti.

90199.commentary: (ANa) ekissā vā tiṇ'odakadattiyā vimānito'ti ekadivasaṃ ekena tiṇ'odakadānena vimānito, ekadivasamattaṃ aladdhatiṇ'odako'ti attho. ito param'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rasānaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato ekissā vā tiṇ'odakadattiyā vimānito dvīhi vā tīhi vā catūhi vā pañcahi vā tiṇ'odakadattīhi vimānito saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
